instructions:
# How to translate this chunk

This file holds `items`, a list of `{"k", "ctx", "t"}`. `t` is English text
that a reader of an Indian app or website sees. `ctx` is the field it came
from, such as label, hint, button, documents, brief or title. Use it to judge
tone and length: a label stays short, a hint can be a sentence.

Write `{"items": [{"k": ..., "t": ...}, ...]}` to the path in `write_to`.
Keep every `k` unchanged and in the same order. Put the translation in `t`.
Leave out `ctx`. Do not add, merge, split or drop items.

## Keep these exactly as they are

- Placeholders and markup: `{0}`, `{name}`, `%s`, `%d`, `%1$s`, HTML tags, `\n`.
- Website addresses, e-mail addresses and links.
- Every number: phone and toll-free numbers, Aadhaar, account, IFSC, PAN, PIN
  codes, amounts, dates, percentages. Write digits as 0-9, the Western digits,
  in every language, including Urdu. People type these into forms that take
  Western digits.
- Acronyms people know in Latin letters: OTP, PAN, IFSC, UPI, KYC, e-KYC, DBT,
  BPL, APL, NFSA, PM-KISAN, SMS, PDF, ID.

## Names

- Product, app, portal and scheme names: transliterate them into the script so
  they read naturally. Keep any acronym inside them in Latin, so "APPSC
  portal" becomes APPSC followed by the word for portal.
- A button or menu label quoted from a website, such as 'Apply Online' or
  'Register', stays in English inside quotes. The reader has to find that exact
  English word on the screen.
- People and places in examples are transliterated, never replaced with other
  names.
- Government office titles are transliterated so the reader can say them at
  the counter: Tahsildar, Patwari, Talathi, Mamlatdar, BDO, Collector, Gram
  Panchayat. The language notes below give the usual local forms.

## Tone

Write for an ordinary person who may be elderly and may have had little
schooling. Use everyday spoken language, not heavy official vocabulary. Where
people really say the English word, write it in the script: online, form,
portal, login, mobile, bank, certificate, download, upload, app. Keep
instructions short and direct, in the form "do this".

"Gender" means sex (male or female). It is never the word for caste.

## Before you write

Check that you have the same number of items as the input and that every
number and placeholder came through. Write the whole file in ONE Write call,
as valid UTF-8 JSON with no `\u` escapes and nothing else in the file.

## Hindi (hi)

Script: Devanagari. Used in UP, MP, Bihar, Rajasthan, Haryana, HP, Uttarakhand,
Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Delhi, and understood across the north.
Tone: everyday spoken Hindi (Hindustani). Avoid Sanskritised official words.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बैंक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन,
सर्टिफिकेट, डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: आवेदन करें (Apply), जमा करें (Submit), आगे (Next), पीछे (Back), खोजें (Search),
शेयर करें (Share), सेटिंग (Settings), भाषा (Language), मदद (Help).
Offices: तहसीलदार, पटवारी, ग्राम पंचायत, कलेक्टर, ब्लॉक विकास कार्यालय (BDO).
Gender: लिंग (never जाति). Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सितंबर.

## Gujarati (gu)

Script: Gujarati. Used in Gujarat, and spoken in Dadra & Nagar Haveli and
Daman & Diu.
Tone: everyday spoken Gujarati.
Words: ઓનલાઇન, ફોર્મ, પોર્ટલ, લૉગિન, આધાર, બેંક, મોબાઇલ, OTP, હેલ્પલાઇન, સર્ટિફિકેટ / દાખલો,
ડાઉનલોડ, અપલોડ.
UI: અરજી કરો, સબમિટ કરો, આગળ, પાછળ, શોધો, શેર કરો, સેટિંગ્સ, ભાષા, મદદ.
Offices: મામલતદાર, તલાટી, ગ્રામ પંચાયત, કલેક્ટર, તાલુકા પંચાયત.
Gender: જાતિ is caste; use લિંગ. Money: રૂ. 6,000; રૂ. 8 લાખ. September: સપ્ટેમ્બર.

## Marathi (mr)

Script: Devanagari. Used in Maharashtra, and widely in Goa.
Tone: everyday Marathi as spoken in Maharashtra.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बँक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन, दाखला / सर्टिफिकेट,
डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: अर्ज करा, सबमिट करा, पुढे, मागे, शोधा, शेअर करा, सेटिंग्ज, भाषा, मदत.
Offices: तहसीलदार, तलाठी, ग्रामपंचायत, जिल्हाधिकारी (कलेक्टर), आपले सरकार सेवा केंद्र.
Gender: लिंग. Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सप्टेंबर.

## Bengali (bn)

Script: Bengali. Used in West Bengal and Tripura, and in Assam's Barak Valley
and the Andamans.
Tone: everyday spoken Bengali (চলিত ভাষা), not সাধু ভাষা.
Words: অনলাইন, ফর্ম, পোর্টাল, লগইন, আধার, ব্যাংক, মোবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, সার্টিফিকেট,
ডাউনলোড, আপলোড.
UI: আবেদন করুন, জমা দিন, পরবর্তী, পিছনে, খুঁজুন, শেয়ার করুন, সেটিংস, ভাষা, সাহায্য.
Offices: বিডিও অফিস, গ্রাম পঞ্চায়েত, তহসিলদার, জেলাশাসক (কালেক্টর), দুয়ারে সরকার.
Gender: লিঙ্গ. Money: 6,000 টাকা; 8 লাখ টাকা. September: সেপ্টেম্বর.

## Assamese (as)

Script: Bengali script with the Assamese letters ৰ and ৱ. Used in Assam.
This is Assamese, not Bengali. Use Assamese words and spellings: আঁচনি
(scheme), বেংক (bank), কৰক (do), নহয় (is not).
Words: অনলাইন, প্ৰপত্ৰ / ফৰ্ম, পৰ্টেল, লগইন, আধাৰ, বেংক, মবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, প্ৰমাণপত্ৰ,
ডাউনল'ড, আপল'ড.
UI: আবেদন কৰক, দাখিল কৰক, পৰৱৰ্তী, উভতি যাওক, বিচাৰক, শ্বেয়াৰ কৰক, ছেটিংছ, ভাষা, সহায়.
Offices: চক্ৰ বিষয়াৰ কাৰ্যালয় (Circle Office), গাঁও পঞ্চায়ত, উন্নয়ন খণ্ড কাৰ্যালয় (BDO),
জিলা উপায়ুক্ত.
Gender: লিংগ. Money: 6,000 টকা; 8 লাখ টকা. September: ছেপ্তেম্বৰ.

## Punjabi (pa)

Script: Gurmukhi. Used in Punjab and Chandigarh, and spoken in Delhi and
Haryana.
Tone: everyday spoken Punjabi.
Words: ਆਨਲਾਈਨ, ਫਾਰਮ, ਪੋਰਟਲ, ਲੌਗਇਨ, ਆਧਾਰ, ਬੈਂਕ, ਮੋਬਾਈਲ, OTP, ਹੈਲਪਲਾਈਨ, ਸਰਟੀਫਿਕੇਟ,
ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ, ਅਪਲੋਡ.
UI: ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦਿਓ, ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰੋ, ਅੱਗੇ, ਪਿੱਛੇ, ਖੋਜੋ, ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕਰੋ, ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ, ਭਾਸ਼ਾ, ਮਦਦ.
Offices: ਤਹਿਸੀਲਦਾਰ, ਪਟਵਾਰੀ, ਸੇਵਾ ਕੇਂਦਰ, ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਪੰਚਾਇਤ, ਡਿਪਟੀ ਕਮਿਸ਼ਨਰ.
Gender: ਲਿੰਗ. Money: ₹6,000; ₹8 ਲੱਖ. September: ਸਤੰਬਰ.

## Odia (or)

Script: Odia. Used in Odisha.
Tone: everyday spoken Odia.
Words: ଅନଲାଇନ, ଫର୍ମ, ପୋର୍ଟାଲ, ଲଗଇନ, ଆଧାର, ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ, ମୋବାଇଲ, OTP, ହେଲ୍ପଲାଇନ, ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ,
ଡାଉନଲୋଡ, ଅପଲୋଡ.
UI: ଆବେଦନ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଦାଖଲ କରନ୍ତୁ, ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ, ପଛକୁ, ଖୋଜନ୍ତୁ, ସେୟାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ସେଟିଂସ୍, ଭାଷା, ସାହାଯ୍ୟ.
Offices: ତହସିଲଦାର, ବିଡିଓ, ଗ୍ରାମ ପଞ୍ଚାୟତ, ଜିଲ୍ଲାପାଳ (କଲେକ୍ଟର), ମୋ ସେବା କେନ୍ଦ୍ର.
Gender: ଲିଙ୍ଗ. Money: ଟ.6,000; ଟ.8 ଲକ୍ଷ. September: ସେପ୍ଟେମ୍ବର.

items.t: Haryana's extension of Ayushman Bharat: Rs 5 lakh a year of cashless hospital treatment for the whole family. Families whose income in the Family ID (PPP) is up to Rs 1.80 lakh are covered free. Families above that can join by paying a yearly fee online: Rs 1,500 for income up to Rs 3 lakh, Rs 4,000 up to Rs 6 lakh and Rs 5,000 above Rs 6 lakh. For the cover year 1 November 2026 to 31 October 2027, the fee portal is open until 30 November 2026.
Rs 5 lakh a year per family, cashless; free up to Rs 1.80 lakh income
Families living in Haryana with a Family ID (PPP). Eligibility and the fee go by the verified income in the PPP
Verified income up to Rs 1.80 lakh a year: covered free
Above Rs 1.80 lakh up to Rs 3 lakh: Rs 1,500 a year per family
Above Rs 3 lakh up to Rs 6 lakh: Rs 4,000 a year. Above Rs 6 lakh: Rs 5,000 a year
No limit on family size or age. Every member on the Family ID is covered

Mobile number registered in the Family ID, for the OTP
Aadhaar card of each member, for the card e-KYC
UPI, debit card or net banking to pay the fee, or cash at a CSC
Payment receipt or reference number, as proof that you paid

Save it. Use Check Payment Status on the home page to see the payment and download the receipt.

If your Family ID income is up to Rs 1.80 lakh you pay nothing: get the Ayushman (Chirayu) card made at a CSC, Saral Kendra or empanelled hospital, or yourself on beneficiary.nha.gov.in with Aadhaar e-KYC.
If your income is above Rs 1.80 lakh, open chirayuayushmanharyana.in before 30 November 2026 and tap the apply button.
Accept the terms, enter the Family ID (or Aadhaar) and the OTP sent to the registered mobile, then check the members and the eligibility shown.
Pay the fee shown (Rs 1,500, Rs 4,000 or Rs 5,000) through Canara Bank by UPI, card or net banking, or at a CSC, and download the receipt.
Your cover runs from 1 November 2026 to 31 October 2027. Get each member's card made with Aadhaar e-KYC on beneficiary.nha.gov.in, the Ayushman app or at a CSC.
At an empanelled hospital, go to the Ayushman Mitra desk with the card. Treatment up to Rs 5 lakh a year is cashless, so do not pay cash for a covered treatment.
1800-180-2036 (Ayushman Bharat Haryana toll-free) / 14555 (Ayushman Bharat national helpline)
Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID / PPP)
Haryana Parivar Pehchan Authority, Citizen Resources Information Department (CRID), Haryana

An 8-digit Family ID for every family living in Haryana, holding each member's details, income and bank account in one record. Almost every Haryana scheme uses it, from pensions and ration cards to Chirayu health cover and Lado Lakshmi, so once it is verified you need not prove the same things again. Making or updating it is free. You can create it yourself online, or get it made at a CSC, Saral Kendra or PPP operator.
Free Family ID that opens Haryana schemes and selects you for benefits automatically
Every family living in Haryana should enrol. It gets a permanent 8-digit Family ID
A family living outside Haryana that needs a Haryana service gets a 9-digit temporary ID starting with T
Creating, updating and downloading the Family ID are free, even at an operator. Never pay a fee
Income, caste and other details are verified by the department. Verified details cannot be edited later
Births, deaths and marriages are linked to it, so the record updates itself
Mobile number of the head of family, for OTP
Bank passbook of the head of family and earning members
Income details of every earning member (salary, farming, business)
Caste certificate, if you belong to SC, BC or another category
Disability certificate, if any member is Divyang

Sent to the mobile number linked with that Aadhaar.

Add everyone who lives and eats together. Married daughters go to their husband's Family ID.
Open meraparivar.haryana.gov.in and choose I want to create my PPP, or open the PPP citizen login page and answer NO.
Search with the head of family's Aadhaar and verify the OTP. Then fill in the head's details, address, caste, income and bank account, and add each member with Aadhaar.
Submit and note the acknowledgement number. If the portal asks, download the filled PPP form, have the head of family sign it and upload it. After this, only one change is allowed.
The department verifies income and other details through records and field checks. Checked details are marked Verified.
The 8-digit Family ID comes by SMS. Download it any time on meraparivar.haryana.gov.in with the Family ID and an OTP.
If you cannot do it yourself, a CSC, Antyodaya Saral Kendra or PPP operator does it free. For wrong income or caste, use the correction module or Report Grievance on the PPP site.
0172-4880500 (Family ID helpline, 9 am to 6 pm, Monday to Saturday) / 98886 33322 (PPP helpline)
Deen Dayal Lado Lakshmi Yojana (Lado Lakshmi)
SEWA Department (Social Justice, Empowerment, Welfare of SCs & BCs and Antyodaya), Haryana

Rs 2,100 a month for women aged 23 and above from the poorest families of Haryana. From the second month, Rs 1,100 comes to your savings account and Rs 1,000 is saved for you in a government recurring deposit, paid back with interest when it matures (within five years). You apply only on the official Lado Lakshmi mobile app using your Family ID (PPP). There is no paper form, and any other link or form is fake.
Rs 2,100 a month (Rs 1,100 in hand + Rs 1,000 saved in a government RD)
Woman aged 23 or above. Any number of eligible women in one family can apply
Family income verified in the Family ID (PPP) not more than Rs 1 lakh a year, and the family endorsed as poorest of the poor by the Gram Sabha or Ward Committee

Or family income up to Rs 1.80 lakh if a child in a government school scored over 80% in Class 10 or 12, reached the NIPUN grade level in Classes 1 to 4, or was brought out of malnutrition (SAM/MAM). Mothers of more than three children cannot use this route
She, or her husband if she married into Haryana from another state, has lived in Haryana for at least 15 years
Not for women already getting the old age, widow, Divyang or Ladli allowance or any other government pension, government employees whose family income is above the limit, or income tax payers
Family ID (Parivar Pehchan Patra) with verified income

Haryana residence certificate (15 years)

Vehicle ownership details and HKRN ID, if any
A smartphone, with the mobile number for OTP and the monthly face check

Asked by SMS after verification. If you choose Rs 1,500 or less, Rs 500 is paid and Rs 1,000 still goes into the RD.
Install the Lado Lakshmi app (made by HARTRON for the Haryana government) from Google Play or the App Store. Do not use any other app, link or form.
Register with your mobile number and OTP, choose Apply for the Scheme, enter the Family ID and pick the woman who is applying.
Fill in the Aadhaar, residence, electricity, vehicle and bank details and submit. Note the Registration ID shown on screen.
CRID checks your details against Family ID records within 15 days. If you are eligible, an SMS asks you to choose the monthly amount: confirm it and give consent in the app with your Registration ID.

The District Social Welfare Officer creates your DDLLY ID and PFMS checks the bank account. Payment starts the next month: Rs 2,100 in full the first month, then Rs 1,100 to the account and Rs 1,000 to the RD.
After the first payment, do the face check (Blink to Click) in the app every month, or the money stops. Raise any complaint in the app's grievance window: the DSWO must act within 7 days.
1800-180-2231 (toll-free Lado Lakshmi helpline) / 0172-4880500 (Family ID and verification helpline)
Indira Gandhi Pyari Behna Sukh-Samman Nidhi Yojana (Rs 1,500 for Women)
Department of Social Justice & Empowerment (Directorate of Empowerment of SCs, OBCs, Minorities & Specially Abled), Government of Himachal Pradesh

Rs 1,500 a month for women of Himachal Pradesh from families with an income below Rs 2 lakh a year and no government job or pension. It began in 2023 in Lahaul-Spiti as the Indira Gandhi Mahila Samman Nidhi. In 2026 the rules were tightened: the income limit came in April, so earlier applications had to be made again, and from June the age is 21 to 59. Only one woman per family is paid and BPL families come first. You apply on a free form at the Tehsil Welfare Officer's office, and payments are being started area by area after verification.
Rs 1,500 a month (Rs 18,000 a year), by DBT
A woman who is a permanent (bonafide) resident of Himachal Pradesh, aged 21 to 59
Family income below Rs 2 lakh a year; BPL families get priority
Only one woman in a family can get the money

Not eligible if anyone in the family is a regular, contract, outsourced or daily-wage government employee or a pensioner, a serving or retired soldier or a soldier's widow, or works for a panchayat, urban body, board or corporation
Not eligible if anyone in the family is an Anganwadi worker or helper, ASHA, mid-day meal or multi-task worker, gets a social security pension, pays income tax or is registered for GST

Indira Gandhi Sukh Shiksha Yojana (Rs 1,000 a Month for Children)
Directorate of Women & Child Development, Government of Himachal Pradesh

Education help for the children of widows, divorced, destitute or abandoned women, and of parents with 70% or more disability, when the family earns up to Rs 1 lakh a year. It was announced in 2024 as the Mukhya Mantri Sukh Shiksha Yojana. Children up to 18 get Rs 1,000 a month. From 18 to 27 the state pays the fees for a degree, diploma or professional course in a government institution in Himachal, and the government hostel and mess charges, or Rs 3,000 a month for rent where there is no hostel. You apply on the HimSeva portal or at a Lok Mitra Kendra.
Rs 1,000 a month per child up to 18; fees, hostel and mess (or Rs 3,000 a month rent) from 18 to 27
